items.summary: Costco Wholesale has been in focus after a holiday period that combined wider Black Friday discounts, strong online promotion, and extended delivery and marketplace partnerships with platforms like DoorDash and Uber Eats. items.title: Does Lyft (LYFT) Merit A Discount After Its Driver Rewards Deal?
items.summary: Lyft shares closed at US$16.14 after a mixed run that includes a sharp decline over the past five years, and the question now is whether that price still lines up with what the company is earning. Recent stock swings and fresh partnership news put the focus squarely on how much of Lyft’s current valuation can be explained by its profit potential. items.title: Bernstein’s $250 Target Says DoorDash’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash stock is 31% below its August high after Amazon gave Prime members free Uber Eats delivery and the Justice Department reportedly moved to review DoorDash’s Instacart deal. Bernstein cut its DoorDash target to $250 from $270 and kept its Outperform rating, a target 53% above the stock.
